about_short_description.short_description: Persana AI is an intelligent sales copilot that is powered by its own custom fine-tuned models.

product.name: Autopilot 2.0
product.description: An AI-driven platform that automates B2B sales engagement by deploying custom-trained AI agents to find, engage, and convert leads across multiple channels.

product.name: Persana AI API
product.description: A flexible API providing programmatic access to detailed, real-time B2B contact and company data for enrichment and lead generation.

product.name: Lookalike Company Search
product.description: An AI-powered tool that identifies companies similar to a given customer profile to generate targeted prospect lists.

product.name: Salesforce Integration (Ella)
product.description: A Salesforce app that integrates Persana’s prospecting, data enrichment, and messaging capabilities directly within Salesforce.

product.name: Chrome Extension
product.description: A browser extension for LinkedIn and Gmail that facilitates lead discovery, data enrichment, and outreach directly from the browser.
